label: Full name
description: Published or authorised name of a named professional contact.

label: Current role title
description: Current source wording for the person's professional role.

label: Professional email
description: Explicitly published or authorised professional-use email; never a guessed pattern.

label: Personal email candidate
description: Personal email not requested by default; if returned incidentally by approved FullEnrich contact enrichment, retain it as a separate personal-email candidate with provider provenance and verification status.

label: Professional phone
description: Explicitly published or authorised professional business phone.

label: Mobile or direct dial
description: Mobile number returned by approved FullEnrich contact enrichment for a selected contact; actively sought, stored separately from business phone and not required by itself for review readiness.

label: Secondary email
description: Secondary professional-use email retained only when encountered without paid lookup.

label: Farrier professional status
description: Current Farrier working status using the provisional Unitalk taxonomy.

label: Primary professional credential
description: One primary current professional credential retained for compatibility with the canonical fixture contract.

label: Professional certifications
description: Current explicitly verified Farrier certifications or memberships.

label: Years of experience
description: Explicitly stated professional years of experience; never derived from age or graduation year without an approved rule.

label: Public professional profile URLs
description: Role-relevant public professional profile URLs explicitly linked from the official website, recorded by an authorised human, or returned through a separately approved official API. The link may be retained without opening or extracting the social profile.

label: Recent professional activity
description: Dated public professional activity kept separate from private interests and CRM engagement.

label: Broad social signals
description: Broad social metrics or inferred interests. Disabled until a permitted signal, purpose and access route are approved.

label: Organisation or business name
description: Verified public or authorised trading/business name.

label: Official website
description: Verified official business website URL.

label: Official website domain
description: Normalised official domain used as one identity signal, never as a unique match by itself.

label: Organisation public professional profile URLs
description: Public business social-profile URLs explicitly linked from the organisation's official website, recorded by an authorised human, or returned through a separately approved official API. The link may be retained without opening or extracting the social profile.

label: Organisation general phone
description: General published business phone used as a fallback when no named target-role channel is available.

label: Organisation general email
description: General published business email used as a fallback when no named target-role channel is available.

label: Public business location
description: Structured public business location. Attempt the complete address when available; state and country are the minimum verified components.

label: Farrier service area
description: Explicit service regions stored as structured region labels plus preserved source wording.

label: Equine disciplines
description: Explicit professional or organisation disciplines; multiple values permitted.

label: Verified exact horse count
description: Verified exact count. Existing matched HubSpot Contact.owner_horse_count is authoritative; net-new prospects may use explicit approved evidence. Never inferred.

label: A2 horse-count review band
description: Deprecated historical A2 field. Do not create new values; horse_count_range is ignored.

label: Stable or farm type
description: Normalised organisation type using the provisional Unitalk taxonomy.

label: Horse breeds
description: At least one explicitly verified breed value is required for Horse Owner enrichment completeness. Preserve verified Mixed or Other values as stated.

label: Horses served per month
description: Aggregate Farrier business volume. Disabled until Equinet confirms a use case and permitted source.

label: Aggregate client-base summary
description: Aggregate business client types or size only; named client identities are prohibited.

label: Person-to-organisation role
description: Verified relationship role between a retained person and organisation.

label: Target-role priority
description: Normalised Unitalk role priority derived from the approved targeting table.

label: Buying-role recommendation
description: Non-binding recommendation derived from a verified role; human approval is required before CRM mapping.

label: Mutual connections
description: Mutual-connection information. Disabled until an authorised official source, account, purpose and storage rule are approved.
